topic: Stable matching with strict complete two-sided preferences
beneficiary: A learner follows why a held proposal can change, finds an actual blocking pair in another complete matching, and sees how the proposing side selects among stable outcomes.

input.size: Both sides have the same1..4participants. Every row is a dense strict permutation of numeric indices0..n-1. No ties, duplicates, missing or extra participants; no coercion of booleans,strings,fractions or nonfinite values.
input.label_convention: Left A/B/C/D, right W/X/Y/Z, truncated to group size. API identity is index; UI translates explicit best-first label rows without repairing invalid orders.

public_api.traceStableMatching: Validate/detach input; choose lowest-index free proposer; it proposes once to its next untried receiver. Receiver holds a first proposal, replaces an inferior incumbent, or rejects the new proposal. Record initial state and every atomic proposal decision; final complete matching and complete matching enumeration are returned as frozen JSON-safe data.
public_api.inspectMatching: Validate one complete left-to-right permutation and return both one-based rank arrays, all blocking-pair witnesses in left/right index order, and stable iff no witness exists.
public_api.listCompleteMatchings: Enumerate every left-to-right permutation in lexicographic order (at most24), with complete blocking-pair/rank evidence. No random search.

trace_contract.matching_identity: Every state stores leftMatching/rightMatching with null for free participants; free proposers and their next-choice cursors are retained. Held pairs are provisional until the algorithm ends.
invariants: Input remains unchanged and every returned array/object is frozen.
Every proposal is unique for its proposer/receiver pair; proposal count<=n*n.
Each state is a valid partial one-to-one matching; each receiver keeps its best proposal so far.
Final matching is complete, has no blocking pair, and each proposer's rank equals its best rank among all enumerated stable matchings.
trace_contract.scope: Complete strict equal-size one-to-one preference model only. Ranks are ordinal positions, not cardinal utilities. Stability and proposer optimality do not claim fairness, uniqueness, maximum weight or a real allocation.

ui.draft: Explicit Apply preferences; editing preference text, group size or proposing side retires result/trace download. Group-size changes explicitly reset rows. Invalid rows remain visible and are refused without silent repair.
ui.inspection: Reversible First/Back/Next/Finish and exact step selector; held-pair diagram plus readable partial-pair/state tables; completed result and proposal count labelled separately from current step.
ui.matching_examination: Select any complete matching from at most24; inspect all blocking witnesses or confirmed absence. Stable alternatives and ordinal ranks remain available.
ui.downloads: Original fixed course JSON and Markdown bytes; current observation with full applied preferences, full trace/enumeration, selected step, inspected matching and exact source hashes. Download does not import or trust derived results.
ui.offline: Standalone direct file, no network/storage/provider/account. Native keyboard and390px/desktop visual receiving and original downloaded lesson import through current unchanged learner are required.

course.content: Original prompts/options/worked explanations/transfer prompts; balanced correct positions. Independent reviewer answers a question-only freeze before seeing the key.
references: Gale and Shapley (1962), College Admissions and the Stability of Marriage, https://www.rand.org/content/dam/rand/pubs/papers/2012/P2240.pdf
Princeton official Algorithm Design stable-matching lectures, https://www.cs.princeton.edu/courses/archive/spring18/cos423/lectures/01StableMatching-2x2.pdf
course.source_use: Original examples, prose and implementation; references establish mathematical background. No reproduced paper exercises or diagrams.

shared_write_limit: One optional additive README discovery paragraph after qualification; all existing learner/deck/model/catalog/course/workflow/dependency files stay exact.
